items.title: Levie：美国公司的前沿级模型开放权重——「3个月前说出去没人信」
items.en_title: If you told someone 3 months ago that a model released by a US company with frontier-class capability would be available as open weights they wouldn't believe it.
items.full_text:
If you told someone 3 months ago that a model released by a US company with frontier-class capability would be available as open weights they wouldn’t believe it. 

This is very important because it opens up AI adoption in a range of scenarios that weren’t viable before. Models can be deployed on prem or in the cloud on private infra, which means use-cases in highly regulated domains can be opened up.

You can also now post-train a frontier class model on specific vertical use-cases that need extra levels of performance for their tasks, like in legal, healthcare, and other spaces. You also ensure sovereignty in case any models ever get pulled from the marketplace, which gives users more confidence in deploying in certain mission critical areas.

All of this is great news for the applied AI layer, because this is where you can route work to different model families based on the task at hand. Great time to building at the harness layer given the options available now.

And closed frontier models will still be heavily used both due to simplicity and because you tend to need a mix of capability level for any hard problem, but having open weights in the mix helps defray costs and provides more flexibility. Great news all around.
items.author: Aaron Levie
items.summary: Box CEO Levie长评：美国公司的前沿级能力模型以开放权重放出，解锁此前不成立的采用场景——可部署到本地/私有云，高监管行业（法律、医疗）得以进入；可在垂直场景post-train；主权性确保模型下架也不怕。结论：应用层可按任务路由到不同模型家族，「现在是构建harness层的最好时机」；闭源前沿模型仍会被重度使用，但开放权重摊薄成本、提供弹性。8.99万浏览。
items.analysis: 「harness层最好时机」与上周Agent Plugins标准、Gauntlet Loop同一条线：模型供给的多样化（开放权重入局）正在把竞争焦点推向编排与路由层。对企业AI团队：模型主权与可替代性正式成为采购维度。
items.recommendation: Levie：前沿模型开放权重落地，「harness层的最好时机」——9万浏览

items.author: xQc Live
items.summary: 顶流主播xQc在直播中出价求购昨日宣布开发终止的Terraria最大Mod「Calamity Mod」，称正与经纪人推进购买事宜——直播切片392万浏览、3万赞。前情：该Mod因管理员被匿名告发引发创作者撤离潮，团队声明法律上不允许fork或再上传，GitHub权限与未付报酬仍系于失联管理员Ozzatron。收购能否解开这团乱麻未知。

items.recommendation: xQc求购Calamity Mod：392万浏览，收购难解权限与授权死结

items.title: Meng To新作：three.js交互高塔场景，天气与昼夜实时联动——8.9万浏览
items.en_title: I made an interactive three.js site that constructs towers with weather and time of day effects.
items.full_text:
I made an interactive three.js site that constructs towers with weather and time of day effects.

I went from making mostly static sites with huge images to three.js with highly textured, detailed 3D models, and the entire site is under 1-2mb. Because it's 3D, you can ask AI to customize everything: themed towers from different countries, ancient and modern styles, weather like snow and rain, lighting from morning to night.

The surprising part is that with a solid foundation it creates those changes pretty much one-shot. It's like starting a design system, where the AI figures out how to stay consistent in quality with the rest of the design. The hard part is avoiding 3D slop, which is easier thanks to Opus 5 and open-source projects.

I used Claude Code for the harness, Higgsfield to generate textures and soundfx/music.

Let me know if you'd like the open-source.

Inspiration: https://t.co/8baUIvsKek

Btw, I love that we get auto-translated posts from around the world. It really expands our horizon in terms of inspiration.
